extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: stagecoach without horses, 5.1 m long incl. pole, 2.05 m wide, 2.8 m tall, rear wheels 1.44 m, front wheels 1.04 m
extras.notes: Concord style coach: red lacquered body with gold pinstripes, cream window frames with rolled leather curtains, padded benches inside, arched roof with brass luggage rail, two trunks and a carpet bag, driver's box with seat, footboard and brake lever, two glowing coach lamps, leather thoroughbraces, yellow running gear and pole with doubletree. Moving parts: doors 'stagecoach_door_left' (+X) and 'stagecoach_door_right' (-X), origin on the front hinge (rotate around local Z), wheels 'stagecoach_wheel_fl/fr/rl/rr' with the origin in the hub (rotate around local X). Pole points to -Y

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
